title: Introduce CI telemetry proxy and smallfoot dependency reshaper
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added a lightweight CI telemetry proxy to centralize and reduce noise for premerge runs; introduced a dependency reshaper that trims dev/test-only transitive deps for faster CI start and smaller images. No user-facing API changes.
body: Summary: Adds a small CI-side telemetry proxy and a 'smallfoot' dependency reshaper that rewrites devcontainer/CI dependency sets to remove unnecessary transitive dev deps. This reduces presubmit flakiness, lowers container image sizes for runners, and centralizes CI telemetry sampling so we can measure presubmit latency and cache hit rates without spamming production observability.
commits: c07b1a9: wire telemetry proxy into GitHub Actions composite wrapper
d2f5b0e: implement smallfoot dependency reshaper CLI with yarn/pip heuristics
b6a90d1: add unit tests for reshaper heuristics and integration smoke for proxy
e9c8f22: update CI templates to call proxy and reshaper in presubmit fastpath
review_comments: Arjun Patel (reviewer): Nice approach to centralizing telemetry. A few nits: 1) Can we limit the proxy sampling rate to 1% by default to avoid initial noise? 2) Add a circuit-breaker so if the proxy fails we don't block presubmit runs.

Maya Chen (author): Added sample_rate config with default 0.01 and a local fallback mode. Implemented a simple in-memory circuit breaker that switches to passthrough after 3 consecutive failures; documented behavior in infra/ci/telemetry-proxy/README.md.

Lena Müller (reviewer): smallfoot heuristics look promising. Request: add a quick benchmark showing cold-start time before/after reshaper on a representative fastpath image. Also ensure we don't prune deps listed explicitly in workspace manifests.

Maya Chen (author): Added micro-benchmark script (tools/smallfoot-reshaper/bench/cold_start.md) and a check that preserves explicit manifest entries. Benchmarks show median cold-start improvement ~14% on linux runners.
Diego Ramos (approver): Integration smoke passed in staging. Left one suggestion around logging level for the proxy, but fine to adjust post-merge. Approving for squash merge.
ci_checks: lint: pass (auto-fix applied to a few files)
notes: Rollout: started as staged rollout on .github/workflows/presubmit-fastpath for ~10% of PRs via random routing; observed lower flakiness and reduced runner image pull times. Telemetry: added a dedicated telemetry tag 'ci.presubmit.smallfoot' to allow dashboards to be sliced. Ops: created a short runbook and alert (docs/runbooks/ci-telemetry-proxy.md).
observability_impact: Introduces a new low-volume metric stream: presubmit_telemetry_events (sampled) and smallfoot_image_size_bytes. Both are namespaced under ci.* and are tagged by repo and job-type.
test_plan: Unit tests for reshaper heuristics and proxy health checks included. Ran presubmit-fastpath against a canary set of repos for 72 hours. Smoke integrations in staging validated fallback behavior. CI jobs were re-run after auto-fix lint changes.
backout_plan: Revert the presubmit-fastpath template change in infra/ci/actions/presubmit-wrapper.yml and roll proxy container to previous image. The proxy runs as optional; if proxy is unhealthy, presubmit falls back to passthrough mode.
related_work: References ENG-8123 (CI observability initiative) and ENG-8150 (reduce presubmit latency). Also follows up on SUP-2042 incident where noisy telemetry contributed to alert fatigue.
maintainers_notified: @infra-team via #infra-ci and sent a short RFC summary to the eng-tools mailing list.
notes_for_releaser: No release artifact; infra change only. Ensure infra/ci/telemetry-proxy image is pushed to internal registry with tag stable-2026-03-06. Update deploy notes in docs/runbooks/ci-telemetry-proxy.md after deployment.

Run image-size sweep across top-10 repos to validate smallfoot savings
